events.title: Marc Andreessen and Jim Clark found Netscape
events.summary: Marc Andreessen and Jim Clark founded Mosaic Communications Corporation on April 4, 1994 — later renamed Netscape Communications.
events.about: Netscape Navigator became the dominant browser of the mid-1990s and drove the first dot-com wave. Andreessen brought Mosaic experience from NCSA; Clark brought Silicon Graphics credibility and venture backing.

narrative.whyChosen: Netscape turned the web from research curiosity into a commercial platform.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved browsers could be venture-backed products and set the first browser wars.
narrative.problemSolved: The web needed a polished, fast browser company to scale beyond academia.
